c.name: Baby Touch
c.translated: This is a translation. If it differs from the Japanese version, the Japanese version prevails.
lp.a1: Sound is at the heart of the play, so the app plays sound even when the iPhone is set to silent. To mute it, choose None for Volume in the grown-ups menu.
lp.a2: Yes, with iPhone’s Guided Access. Turn it on in Settings > Accessibility > Guided Access, then open Baby Touch and quickly press the side button three times to start. To end it, press the side button three times again and enter your passcode.
lp.a3: The screen slowly turns to night, a music-box lullaby plays, and it ends with “Good night.” After that, touches only bring out small stars. To play again, a grown-up taps “Play again.”
lp.a4: It’s a one-time purchase: you pay once when you buy it on the App Store. There are no in-app purchases, subscriptions or ads. See the App Store for the price.
lp.a5: Neither. The app never goes online, so it works in Airplane Mode too.
lp.a6: Only on your iPhone. Nothing is sent anywhere, and deleting the app removes them.
lp.a7: It’s designed for little ones from about 6 months to 2 years. Please stay nearby while they play and keep sessions short.
lp.adult_2: Whether to move on to the next game automatically. It’s on by default and switches about every 75 seconds
lp.adult_3: Volume has four levels: None, Low, Medium and High
lp.adult_4: Vibration can be turned on or off
lp.adult_note: Using it together with iPhone’s Guided Access keeps your child from switching apps or going back to the Home Screen. See the FAQ below for how.
lp.adult_p: Press and hold the lock button at the top right for 3 seconds to open it, so a child’s touch won’t open it by accident.
lp.desc: An iPhone app where touching anywhere on the screen brings back sound, vibration and colorful pops. Made for little ones from about 6 months to 2 years. No ads, no in-app purchases and no network connection, so it works even in Airplane Mode.
lp.g1_p: Shapes with faces pop out where you touch, with marimba notes: low on the left, high on the right. They bounce and pile up at the bottom.
lp.g2_p: Bubbles float up the screen and pop when touched. Hold a finger down to blow one big bubble.
lp.g3_p: Four big pads: drum, bell, maracas and xylophone. Each tap on the xylophone plays the next note of Twinkle Twinkle Little Star.
lp.g4_p: Touch the sky for an airplane or helicopter, the rails for a steam train, and the road for a car, bus, ambulance, fire truck or police car, each with its own sound.
lp.g5_p: Fireworks go up where you touch, bursting into rings, hearts, stars and smiley faces while the iPhone gives a big vibration.
lp.g6_p: An animal is covering its eyes. Touch it and... peekaboo! A bear, cat, rabbit, panda, pig and dog take turns.
lp.games_p: Pick a game in the grown-ups menu. After a while, the app moves on to the next game by itself.
lp.h1:
Touch anywhere.
Hear it, feel it, see it pop.
lp.how1_p: No need to aim for buttons. The app responds right away wherever the screen is touched.
lp.how2_p: Every touch makes a sound and the iPhone vibrates in their hands. Something to see, hear and feel.
lp.how3_p: Slap the screen with a whole palm and one special, big reaction appears.
lp.lead: A touch-and-play app for little ones from about 6 months to 2 years. No precise tapping needed. Touch anywhere on the screen and it makes a sound, the iPhone vibrates, and colors and shapes pop out. There are six games. No ads, no in-app purchases and no internet connection, so you can hand it over with peace of mind.
lp.q1: Why does it play sound when my iPhone is on silent?
lp.q2: Can I stop my child from leaving the app?
lp.q3: What happens when the timer ends?
lp.q5: Do I need an account or internet connection?
lp.q6: Where are settings and play time saved?
lp.q8: Which devices does it work on?
lp.safe1_p: The app never connects to the internet. Every game works in Airplane Mode.
lp.safe2_p: Not a single ad. Little fingers can’t tap into an ad and end up somewhere unexpected.
lp.safe3_p: Buying it once on the App Store gets you everything. The app never asks for more money, and there are no subscriptions.
lp.safe4_p: No accounts, no logins and no analytics. Neither names nor how the app is used are sent anywhere.
lp.safe_note: There are no effects that flash the whole screen, and a limiter keeps sounds from suddenly getting too loud.
lp.store_note: A paid app for iPhone. Buy it once and there is nothing more to pay.
lp.support_p: If something isn’t working or you have a question, please use the contact page or email ryo.tsuzukihashi@tsuzukit.com.
lp.title: Baby Touch | A no-ads iPhone app for babies: touch anywhere and it plays
pp.buy_p: The app is a paid app on the App Store. Apple handles payment, and card or other payment details never reach the developer. The app never asks for purchases inside the app.
pp.change_p: If the app’s features change, we will update this page. Major changes will be announced here.
pp.contact_p: For questions about this policy, please use the contact page or email ryo.tsuzukihashi@tsuzukit.com.
pp.del_p: Deleting the app removes all settings and play time from your iPhone. The developer keeps no copy.
pp.desc: Privacy Policy for Baby Touch. The app never goes online and collects no personal information from children or anyone else. Settings and play time stay on your iPhone.
pp.h_3: 3. No network, and what is not included
pp.kids_p: The app is designed for babies and toddlers. It collects no personal information from children or from anyone else. That includes the children’s personal information protected by the U.S. Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA): none is collected.
pp.lede:
Summary
Baby Touch never connects to the internet. There is no account or login, and it never asks for a name or email address. It contains no ads, no analytics, no crash reporting and no third-party SDKs. Settings and play time are saved only on your iPhone and are never sent anywhere, including to the developer.
pp.link_p: The app links to only two outside pages: this privacy policy and the support page. Both are inside the grown-ups menu, which opens only after holding the lock button at the top right for 3 seconds. They lead to pages on tsuzukit.com; see “9. About this website” for how that site handles information.
pp.local_p: Both are kept only in UserDefaults, storage on your iPhone. They are never sent to the developer’s servers or to any other company, and they are removed when you delete the app.

pp.title: Privacy Policy - Baby Touch
pp.use_p: Settings and play time are used on your iPhone only to make the app work. If you contact us, we use your email address and message only to reply. We never share them with third parties without your consent, except as required by law.
pp.web_p: tsuzukit.com, including this page, uses Google Analytics to understand traffic and Google AdSense to show ads. Both use cookies. You can refuse cookies in your browser settings. This applies to the website only; the app itself has no ads or analytics.

tos.ban_p: When using the App, you must not do any of the following.
tos.c1: Stay nearby and play together with your child
tos.c2: Keep each session short. You can use the timer in the grown-ups menu
tos.c3: Keep a comfortable distance so the screen isn’t too close to their eyes
tos.c4: Start with a low volume and set it to a level that suits your child’s ears. To play without sound, set Volume to None in the grown-ups menu
tos.c5: To keep your child in the App, use iPhone’s Guided Access
tos.c6: Make sure your child doesn’t drop the iPhone or put it in their mouth
tos.c7: Stop playing if your child seems unwell or not like themselves
